title: 8 Frames in 16ms: Rollback Networking in Mortal Kombat and Injustice 2
summary: A 2018 GDC talk by NetherRealm's Michael Stallone on the engine changes, optimizations and tooling needed to roll back and re-simulate up to 8 frames in 16 ms in Mortal Kombat and Injustice 2. It is a deep dive into deterministic rollback netcode.
why: HN treats it as the definitive practical talk on rollback networking in a shipped AAA fighting game.

quote.text: For an in-depth explanation, see this excellent GDC talk on its implementation in Mortal Kombat and Injustice 2
